sources.title: Efficient Multi-Task Modeling through Automated Fusion of Trained Models
sources.snippet: Inspired by the rapid development and excellent performance of single-task models, this paper proposes an efficient multi-task modeling method that can automatically fuse trained single-task models with different structures and tasks to form a multi-task model.
